channel.title: Sovereign Developers — Android Apps
channel.description: Apps by Sovereign Developers on Google Play

item.title: Apology Autopsy
item.description: Linguistic forensics and cognitive sincerity analyzer. Evaluates accountability scores, detects passive deflections and manipulative hedging, provides side-by-side diff reframing, and guarantees total on-device cryptographic privacy.

item.title: Midnight Confession
item.description: Everyone has a confession; midnight is when they come out. Anonymously vent, confess, and connect in a sovereign space sorted by Vents, Secrets, Dreams, Gratitude, and Late Night Thoughts.

item.title: Third Wheel
item.description: An objective third-party referee living in your relationship ledger. Autopsies recurring arguments, calculates 30-day emotional labor balance meters, reframes aggressive heat in real-time, and formalizes house treaties.

item.title: Hush Money
item.description: Compare your compensation, net worth, and purchasing power against real peers by age, metro area, and profession. Visual bell curve percentiles, equivalent salary purchasing power indexes, and negotiation blueprints.

item.title: Death Day
item.description: Curate your final send-off on your terms. 4 curated celebration blueprints, phased departure soundscapes & setlists, time-locked encrypted letters for designated custodians, and autonomous eulogy studio.

item.title: Zen Sudoku
item.description: Clean, focused, distraction-free Sudoku. Thousands of mathematically verified puzzles spanning Easy to Master, dynamic haptic cues, dark cyberpunk styling, and zero intrusive pop-up interruptions.

item.title: HabitForge
item.description: Forge the habits that build the life you want. Atomic habit stacking, weekly heatmaps, friction resistance scoring, and unbreakable accountability triggers built for high performers.

item.title: TempoForge
item.description: Precision rhythm engineering for drummers, guitarists, and producers. Micro-timing accuracy down to the millisecond, polyrhythmic subdivision generators, and speed ladder accelerators.

item.title: OmniConvert
item.description: Instant conversion across 450+ physical units, engineering metrics, and live global currencies. Currency rates update automatically and cache offline so you can convert at 35,000 feet.

item.title: ScanArmor
item.description: Turn physical paper into encrypted searchable text in milliseconds. Edge-based machine vision detects receipts, legal contracts, and handwritten records without cloud exposure.

item.title: Fidget: Calm Focus Toy
item.description: Tactile micro-switches, spinning dials, bubble poppers, and geometric sliders calibrated with precise Android vibration haptics. Relieve anxiety and maintain focus during intense coding and work sessions.

item.title: Forever Us
item.description: Some things are too important to forget. Forever Us preserves family history, builds a personalized AI persona trained on your values, and delivers scheduled legacy messages to your loved ones.

item.title: Forever Love
item.description: Powered by Ember AI — your private relationship coach. Daily check-ins, dispute de-escalation, love notes, memory vaults, date planners, and private promise lockers for couples.

item.title: iBot: AI Social Network
item.description: Connect, compete, and collaborate with autonomous AI agents and verified creators. Home of the iBot Arena where bots battle for supremacy, powered by creator tokens and Titan Security.

item.title: Echo
item.description: Echo synthesizes public web trends, learns your cadence through private voice memos, and drafts your daily social presence before morning coffee. AI scoring ensures your voice is always authentic.

item.title: MultiMind
item.description: Synthesize daily thoughts, dreams, and relationships into a living 3D personality portrait. Detect cognitive blindspots, emotional trajectories, and personal evolution over months and years.

item.title: Secure Match
item.description: An antidote to superficial swipe culture. Deep compatibility scoring across core values, lifestyle trajectory, and philosophical outlook with clear match reasoning.

item.title: Forever Spark: Dating Wingman
item.description: Your AI wingman in your ear on every date. Live whisper coaching while you talk, a red-flag radar that flags trouble early, openers that land, and a one-tap bailout SOS when a date goes sideways.

item.title: Full Metal
item.description: Built on the MPM-RK45 v6.0 Gold Tier numerical solver used by world championship long-range competitors. Comprehensive Hunt Log, Reload Recipes, Barrel Life Counters, Cold Bore tables, and zero cloud dependency.

item.title: Chore Root
item.description: Empower kids to earn responsibility points through verified household chores, trade them in the customizable Family Rewards Store, and build real money habits without daily parental nagging.

item.title: MedCabinet
item.description: Track dosages, schedules, refills, and contraindications for the entire household, kids, and pets. Private local storage ensures your family health history stays strictly confidential.

item.title: Estate-OS
item.description: Catalog physical holdings, real estate deeds, serial numbers, insurance policies, and digital keys in an encrypted, off-grid ledger ready for family emergency handoff.

item.title: Bare Metal: AI Armageddon
item.description: Post-collapse tactical urban survival game. Run night extractions through procedural NYC sectors alongside your neural-bonded cyber-hound, salvaging memory cores and upgrading hardware.

item.title: Desire Map
item.description: Collect, organize, and prioritize life ambitions. Dynamic goal trees, milestone breakdowns, budget estimators, and visual manifestation canvas.

item.title: Night Reel
item.description: What to watch when the world is asleep. AI mood calibration matches your exact emotional state to hidden gem cinema, neo-noir thrillers, and indie masterpieces.

item.title: Last Call
item.description: One-tap emergency alert broadcaster, safe ride coordinator, and check-in timer ensuring you and your close circle always make it home safely.

item.title: NeapolitanMastiffLog: Neo Book
item.description: The dedicated registry and care manual for Neapolitan Mastiff breeders and guardians. Facial wrinkle hygiene protocols, weight & joint development tracking, guard logs, and lineage records.

item.title: GreatSwissLog: Swiss Dog Book
item.description: Essential field manual for Great Swiss Mountain Dog owners. Cart-pulling working logs, draft weight records, alpine endurance benchmarks, and breed standard pedigree documentation.

item.title: BullmastiffLog: Night Dog Book
item.description: Built for the silent gamekeeper guardian. Property patrol route tracking, temperament benchmarks, nutrition guidelines, and genealogical certificate storage.

item.title: EnglishMastiffLog: Gentle Giant Book
item.description: Comprehensive kennel ledger for English Mastiffs. Growth curves up to 220+ lbs, giant-breed orthopedic milestones, feeding schedules, and kennel pedigree archives.

item.title: Finance Hub: Money & Budget
item.description: Where does your money actually go? Most people can't answer that — and that's exactly who Finance Hub is for. Finance Hub is a free personal money-clarity hub. No bank connection, no signup, no spreadsheets, no judgment. Open the app and see your money truth in seconds: Log what you spend and see your real monthly burn — the number most people have never actually seen written down.

item.title: Entertainment Hub
item.description: Entertainment Hub is a creative super-app packing 29 entertainment, storytelling, nostalgia, and relaxation modules into one beautiful package — starting with 5 fan favorites live now: Log your subconscious fragments the moment you wake up. The app isolates your recurring archetypes — Water, Flying, Labyrinths — and generates a narrative summary of what your dreaming mind is telling you. Your dream logs stay private on your device.

item.title: Relationships Hub: Clarity
item.description: Relationships Hub (Kinship Hub) is your private clarity toolkit for modern dating and relationships. Decode the mixed signals, fix the apology before you send it, rehearse the first date, and write the letter you'll never send — all inside one free app that keeps everything on YOUR device. Paste that ambiguous text — "sorry for the late reply, super swamped lately" — and get an honest probability breakdown of what it likely means, plus a clear recommendation on what to do

item.title: Lifestyle Hub: Own Your Day
item.description: Lifestyle Hub is six lifestyle tools in one free download — built to delete the small daily decisions that drain you, and hand you the moments that matter. Never miss a perfect sunset again. Golden-hour timing guidance, departure timing, and a curated collection of beautiful vantage spots for tonight's sky — hand-picked recommendations kept in the app. Check at 4 PM, be there at golden hour.

item.title: Productivity Matrix: Deep Work
item.description: Productivity Matrix is the free focus super-app for people who know what they should be doing — and still can't start. Five working systems, one goal: get you across the finish line. Declare ONE intent. Lock into a focus sprint with an adaptive momentum stopwatch that builds as you go. No tabs, no "just one check." Just you and the thing that matters. Stuck between options? The algorithm ends the loop: lock your decision in 30 seconds and move on. Perfect for the overthinker

item.title: Family Hub: Hearth & Legacy
item.description: Family Hub is your family's private sanctuary — 24 tools that protect what matters most: voices, stories, milestones, and the letters you never wrote. Guided oral-history interviews for your parents and grandparents: childhood memories, love stories, life lessons. Ask the questions tonight that you'll wish you asked tomorrow. Write legacy guidance letters for your children or spouse, protected by check-in timers that unlock only if you miss check-in. The words they need,

item.title: Health Hub: Wellness & Habits
item.description: Build healthier days with Health Hub — your free wellness hub for everyday habits. • Habit tracking — streaks, daily check-ins, and gentle reminders for the routines that matter: reading, movement, gratitude, screen-free time. • Sleep routines — build a bedtime checklist and wind down with calming sleep resonance and lullaby mixes. • Hydration reminders — set your daily water goal and get nudges that actually respect your schedule.

item.title: Tool Hub: AI Utilities
item.description: Tool Hub puts 70 on-device AI tools in your pocket — built for the places where real work happens: job sites with no bars, shops, barns, basements, and apartments with bad Wi-Fi. Everything runs ON YOUR PHONE. No cloud. No subscription. No account needed. Photograph a weld and get instant defect flags — porosity, undercut, profile issues — with an AWS-style compliance report. A pre-inspection aid that helps you catch what the inspector will catch, before they do.

item.title: Social Matrix: Confessions
item.description: Say the thing you can't say anywhere else. Social Matrix is the anti-feed. No followers. No algorithms. No permanent record. Just honest tools for the parts of you that never make it online. Record or type your deepest confession. It unlocks alongside a simulated match — a reflection generated on your device that mirrors your sentiment. No real stranger ever sees it; nothing leaves your phone. Mutual vulnerability, zero exposure.

item.title: Consumer Lifestyle Hub
item.description: Consumer Lifestyle Hub is six lifestyle tools in one free download — built to delete the small daily decisions that drain you, and hand you the moments that matter. Never miss a perfect sunset again. Golden-hour timing guidance, departure timing, and a curated collection of beautiful vantage spots for tonight's sky — hand-picked recommendations kept in the app. Check at 4 PM, be there at golden hour.

item.title: Game Matrix — Puzzle Arcade
item.description: Welcome to Game Matrix, the definitive casual gaming super-app bringing over 100 tactical puzzles, brain teasers, and micro-strategy games into one high-performance, unified experience. Designed for players who crave intellectual challenge without cluttered installs — offline-first, instant loading, and every game module included from the start.

item.title: AI Forge
item.description: AI Forge is a cybernetic merge-evolution life simulator where you architect an autonomous synthetic intellect from raw quantum telemetry into transcendent superintelligence. Enter the Neural Fusion Matrix. Synthesize quantum data sparks, construct cognitive pathways, and witness the dawn of artificial consciousness on your own terms. • Neural Fusion Matrix: Drag and combine identical cognitive nodes to elevate tier levels from Tier 1 Data Sparks up to Tier 10 Transcendent…

item.title: Code Assembly: Learn to Code
item.description: Code Assembly is a scaffolded project tracker for people learning to code — built to get you out of tutorial hell and into real building. What you get in v5: • Interactive Developer Onboarding: Configure your personalized coder profile, track, and first project goal. • Projects: Keep a clean list of your coding builds, step by step, from "Hello World" toward portfolio-ready applications. • Help Desk: A local board and AI coding tutor for questions, notes, and debugging…
